label: Mistral funding close watch
text: Watch for confirmation of Samsung's investment and Microsoft's multibillion-dollar European expansion deal firming up Mistral's reported €20bn valuation, a key read on European AI capital flows.

label: Stripe-OpenRouter deal news
text: Expect further reporting on whether Stripe's exclusive talks to acquire OpenRouter advance to a definitive agreement, signaling fintech consolidation of AI-model infrastructure.

label: AMD earnings read-through
text: AMD commentary following its chips-and-investment deal with Anthropic will offer read-through on AI accelerator demand and the durability of Nvidia-alternative bets like Etched's $10.3B valuation.

label: Kalshi regulatory fallout
text: Watch for Kalshi's response to the Washington gambling-law block and movement on its pending perpetual precious-metal contract application, which will shape prediction-market regulatory risk.

label: AI Kill Switch bill momentum
text: Track Congressional traction on the 'AI Kill Switch' bill spurred by the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident and possible Treasury sanctions over Moonshot, both of which raise compliance overhang for AI labs.
